name: Nuvora Timeline for Elementor
author: Sehrish Anam

sections.description:
Nuvora Timeline Elementor adds a fully customizable, animated timeline widget to Elementor. Display events, milestones, or history in a visually stunning way with support for multiple color schemes, animation delays, and icons.

Features:

  • 3 Color Schemes: Purple/Pink, Blue, and Green
  • Smooth fadeInUp animations with customizable delays
  • Fully responsive — looks great on all devices
  • Simple drag-and-drop interface in Elementor
  • Control animation, width, and individual item settings
  • Icon support via LineIcons library
  • Unlimited timeline items

License

sections.installation:
1. Upload the nuvora-timeline-for-elementor folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install via Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Open any page or post in Elementor, search for Timeline in the widget panel, and drag it onto your page.
sections.faq:
Does this require Elementor?

Yes. Elementor 3.0.0 or higher must be installed and activated.

Can I add unlimited timeline items?

Yes, the repeater field allows you to add as many timeline events as needed.

How do I change the colors?

Each timeline item has a Color Scheme selector (Purple/Pink, Blue, Green). You can also enable custom colors per item.
